title: nan
authors: Kong A.; Wang Y.; Zhao J.
key_contribution: Presents IRF-LIL, an infrared rangefinder-fused LiDAR-inertial localization system for UAV bridge inspection in GPS-denied environments, achieving 0.17 m absolute position error in real bridge experiments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
